scope: Initial 10-second quality callbacks only; original public AddCodec and NotifySubscriberMaxQuality, original timers/queue, testing/synctest. No mute/restart, source mutation, Rust/docs edits or integration execution.
source_boundary: Quality timer calls updateQualityChange(true) at dynacastqualityvideo.go:235-238; listener at :223 calls manager OnUpdateMaxQualityForMime, which calls update(false) at dynacastmanagervideo.go:145-155. Pending manager deadline calls update(true) at :204-206.
staging: Offline APFS clones of clean pinned source checkouts and module-cache entries; every tracked source byte checked against git archive. Only a separate observer module gets absolute local replacements. All writable Go caches and outputs are task-owned /tmp/c57-go-*.
normalization: Only codec map order in raw callback capture. Separate projection pins participant.go:2935-2938 SHA256 and converts video/VP8,video/VP9 to vp8,vp9; it does not execute ParticipantImpl or Rust.
timeouts: 600 seconds real time per subprocess; Go test/observer watchdog 60 seconds per invocation. 12000ms per row is virtual synctest time, not wall-clock sleep.
outcome: Recorded only in task work provenance.json after actual execution; these are requested expectations, not a claimed pass.
